title: Feeling ill: Mir tut der Kopf weh (Gesundheit)
summary: Name the parts of the body, say what hurts and how you feel, and get through the doctor's and the pharmacy.
goals: Say what hurts: Mir tut der Kopf weh. Ich habe Kopfschmerzen.
Say how you feel: Ich bin krank. Ich habe Fieber.
Make an appointment and understand simple instructions at the doctor's

nicosWeg.title: Nicos Weg A1, chapter 17: Health (Geht es dir gut?, Beim Arzt, Gute Besserung!, Nehmen Sie ...)

sections.title: What hurts?
sections.text:
Two ways to say it:
- [[Mir tut der Kopf weh.]] = My head hurts. Literally: to me, the head does pain. More than one: [[Mir tun die Füße weh.]]
- [[Ich habe Kopfschmerzen.]] = I have a headache. Also [[Bauchschmerzen]], [[Halsschmerzen]], [[Rückenschmerzen]], [[Zahnschmerzen]].

[[wehtun]] is separable and the person is in the dative (lesson 5): [[Tut dir etwas weh?]] = Does something hurt? [[Wo tut es weh?]] = Where does it hurt?

Russian у меня болит голова has the same shape: the body part is the subject, and the person is not. German puts the person in the dative ([[mir]]), Russian uses у меня. Armenian says գլուխս ցավում է, 'my head hurts', like English.

sections.title: How do you feel?
sections.text:
- [[Wie geht es Ihnen?]] - [[Nicht so gut. Ich bin krank.]]
- [[Ich habe Fieber.]] = I have a temperature.
- [[Ich bin müde.]] (Unit 5)
- [[Mir ist schlecht.]] = I feel sick (I might throw up). Another dative chunk.

To someone who is ill: [[Gute Besserung!]] = Get well soon! And when they're better: [[Bist du wieder gesund?]] = Are you well again?

sections.title: At the doctor's
sections.text:
In Germany you usually go first to a general doctor, [[der Hausarzt]] or [[die Hausärztin]], at a [[Praxis]] (practice). Make an appointment by phone or online: [[Ich möchte einen Termin, bitte. Ich habe Fieber.]] At the reception they ask for your health insurance card: [[Ihre Karte, bitte.]]

What the doctor asks and says:
- [[Was fehlt Ihnen?]] = What's the matter? (a dative chunk)
- [[Seit wann haben Sie Fieber?]] - [[Seit zwei Tagen.]] ([[seit]], lesson 1)
- [[Nehmen Sie die Tabletten dreimal am Tag nach dem Essen.]] = Take the tablets three times a day after meals.
- [[Bleiben Sie zu Hause.]] = Stay at home.

You get the medicine ([[das Medikament]]) at [[die Apotheke]] (the pharmacy). A hospital is [[das Krankenhaus]].

sections.title: Two numbers
sections.text: Emergency (ambulance, fire brigade): 112. A doctor at night or at the weekend, when it's not an emergency: 116 117.
